meta.title: Agnes Forge | AI Image & Video Studio
meta.description: Turn prompts into polished images and videos in one creative workspace.

home.heroSubtitle: AI-powered image and video creation tool. Supports text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, and image-to-video with professional-grade quality and creative control.

prompt.title: Prompt Generator
prompt.desc: Use AI to quickly generate high-quality prompts for images and videos

optimize.title: Prompt Optimizer
optimize.desc: Intelligently optimize your raw prompts for better generation results

textToImage.title: Text to Image
textToImage.desc: Generate high-quality images from text descriptions, supporting 1K~4K

imageToImage.title: Image to Image
imageToImage.desc: Upload a reference image and transform its style or edit it with prompts

textToVideo.title: Text to Video
textToVideo.desc: Directly generate cinematic video clips from text descriptions

imageToVideo.title: Image to Video
imageToVideo.desc: Transform static images into dynamic videos

multiImageVideo.title: Multi-Image Video
multiImageVideo.desc: Animate multiple keyframe images with smooth transitions

promptGen.title: Prompt Generator
promptGen.subtitle: Enter a topic and preferences, let AI generate professional-grade prompts
promptGen.subject: Subject
promptGen.subjectPlaceholder: e.g., A ginger cat in a spacesuit walking on the moon
promptGen.placeholder: Results will appear here after clicking Generate...

promptOpt.title: Prompt Optimizer
promptOpt.subtitle: Paste your original prompt and let AI optimize it for better results
promptOpt.placeholder: e.g., A cat on a table
promptOpt.outputPlaceholder: Results will appear here after clicking Optimize...
promptOpt.hint: Enter the prompt you want to optimize

t2i.title: Text to Image
t2i.subtitle: Enter a prompt and let AI generate high-quality images
t2i.promptPlaceholder: Describe the image you want, e.g., A cute orange cat sitting on a sunny windowsill
t2i.negativePlaceholder: Describe what you don't want to see

i2i.title: Image to Image
i2i.subtitle: Upload a reference image and transform its style or edit it with prompts
i2i.stylePlaceholder: e.g., Oil painting style, impressionism, warm tones
i2i.negativePlaceholder: Describe what you don't want to see

t2v.title: Text to Video
t2v.subtitle: Enter a description and let AI generate high-quality video clips
t2v.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the video you want, e.g., Ocean waves crashing against rocks at sunset, camera slowly pushing in
t2v.negativePlaceholder: Describe what you don't want to see
t2v.seedHint: Set a fixed seed for reproducible results
t2v.stepsHint: Inference steps range 10-100, higher values improve quality but slow generation
t2v.widthPlaceholder: Leave blank to use resolution preset
t2v.widthHint: Set with height to override preset resolution
t2v.heightPlaceholder: Leave blank to use resolution preset
t2v.heightHint: Set with width to override preset resolution

i2v.title: Image to Video
i2v.subtitle: Transform static images into dynamic videos
i2v.videoPlaceholder: Describe the motion you want, e.g., Person slowly turns around, hair blowing in the wind
i2v.negativePlaceholder: Describe what you don't want to see
i2v.seedHint: Set a fixed seed for reproducible results
i2v.stepsHint: Inference steps range 10-100, higher values improve quality but slow generation
i2v.widthPlaceholder: Leave blank to use resolution preset
i2v.widthHint: Set with height to override preset resolution
i2v.heightPlaceholder: Leave blank to use resolution preset
i2v.heightHint: Set with width to override preset resolution

miv.title: Multi-Image Video / Keyframe Animation
miv.subtitle: Provide multiple keyframe images, AI generates smooth transition videos between them
miv.videoPlaceholder: Describe the multi-image video or keyframe animation, e.g., Generate a smooth transition between two images
miv.negativePlaceholder: Describe what you don't want to see
miv.urlLineHint: One public image URL per line
